content.text: Skip to main content menu close Ann Arbor Dearborn Flint Find out about your options for free tuition on each campus: Ann Arbor Dearborn Flint Learn How Affordable a U-M Degree Can Be All three U-M campuses offer the Go Blue Guarantee — free and reduced tuition for up to four years for qualified high-achieving, in-state, full-time undergraduate students. Visit our campus websites for the requirements at each location. Income Threshold Increased on All Three Campuses Michigan families with incomes $125,000 and under & assets below $125,000 now qualify for FREE TUITION. Read the story Success Stories Reap the Rewards that U-M Offers The Go Blue Guarantee is allowing Eli, and other students from a wide range of financial backgrounds, to access all U-M has to offer. You Belong Here Phimmasone, a refugee and mother of three, is now pursuing her education and her dreams thanks to the Go Blue Guarantee.
